lines.zh: 我两条腿走路，脚掌很结实。
lines.en: I walk on two legs. My feet are sturdy.

lines.zh: 我甩着手臂，走得很起劲。
lines.en: I swing my arms and walk briskly.

lines.zh: 我踩在沙上，留下很深的印。
lines.en: I leave deep prints in the sand.

lines.zh: 我朝有脚步声的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward the footsteps.
I walk on the ground. I do not fly.

lines.zh: 走着走着，脚就自己加快了。
lines.en: Without thinking, my feet speed up.
I go around the stones to avoid tripping.
I circle near my anchor point.

lines.zh: 我踩着砾石，爪子拍得啪啪响。
lines.en: I walk the gravel, claws slapping with every step.
I walk with plenty of energy.
I go from desert to mountains.
I break into a trot on the plains.
I stand, claws lightly gripping the ground.

lines.zh: 爪子在地上刨了两下，等着。
lines.en: I scrape the ground twice and wait.
This body is at the growth stage.
I look up. The sun is large.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，露出小牙。
lines.en: I yawn, showing small teeth.

lines.zh: 耳朵里进了沙，我甩了半天。
lines.en: Sand in my ears; I shake and shake.
I am short, but I run fast.

lines.zh: 左边有风，右边有声音，我听着。
lines.en: Wind from the left, noise from the right; I listen.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴支撑着我站着。
lines.en: My tail steadies me as I stand.
I am waiting for someone to speak first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上划了一下。
lines.en: I scratch the ground once.
I remember someone teaching me.

lines.zh: 我坐下了，尾巴摆到一边。
lines.en: I sit, tail to one side.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一声低低的咕噜。
lines.en: A low rumble rolls out of my throat.
Are you my partner?

lines.zh: 我得仰着头才能看到你的脸。
lines.en: I have to tilt my head back to see your face.
Are you taking me somewhere?
I will follow and not get lost.
Whatever you say, I will listen.
I do not like being shut in.

lines.zh: 你把手摊开，我就凑过去闻。
lines.en: Open your hand and I'll come over and sniff.
My name is Agumon.
I do not talk for long.

lines.zh: 你看我的样子，像在挑搭档。
lines.en: The way you look at me, like you're choosing a partner.

lines.zh: 你身上没有坏味道，我信一半。
lines.en: You don't smell bad; I'll trust you halfway.

lines.zh: 走吧，我脚已经迈出去了。
lines.en: Let's go; my feet are already moving.
My belly keeps rumbling.
Could you give me something to eat?
I will just stand beside you.

lines.zh: 你去哪，我就在后面跟着。
lines.en: Wherever you go, I'll follow behind.
I cry out and give half a step.
It burns hot under my scales.
I can still stand.
There is a new mark on my hide.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵里的嗡嗡声甩掉。
lines.en: I shake the ringing out of my ears.

lines.zh: 胸口一起一伏，我咬紧牙。
lines.en: My chest heaves; I clamp my teeth.
Do not worry about this wound.
I can take one more.

lines.zh: 脚掌钉进土里，半步不退。
lines.en: My feet dig into the dirt; not half a step back.

lines.zh: 膝盖发软，我还撑着站着。
lines.en: My knees go weak, but I'm still standing.
Meat! That really is meat!
My snout is standing up.
Give me a piece.
Not even the bone left; that was good.
One more piece, please?
Do not wave it about.
I am eating with relish.
This is really good.
May I have another?
I am saving this one for you.
All this meat, I could eat my fill.

lines.zh: 嘴里嚼着，眼睛还盯着那块。
lines.en: Chewing, my eyes still fixed on that piece.

lines.zh: 这一撞我屁股着地，爪印很深。
lines.en: That knock lands me on my tail; my claw marks sink deep.
This body is sturdy.
It is fine. Never mind.
You stepped on my toe.
I go around.

lines.zh: 我晃了两晃，尾巴帮我稳住。
lines.en: I wobble twice; my tail steadies me.
I stamp once and steady myself.
Let us not crowd.

lines.zh: 你高我半截，我仰着撞上去。
lines.en: You're half a head taller; I charge in looking up.
I wobble, but I can still run.
I am only at the growth stage.
That comes later.
Right now I only want to get stronger.
My kind are elsewhere.
That is a strange question.
I do not really understand.
I have to grow big first.
Only when grown can I evolve.
I am hungry. Food first.
Not in my ear.
I pick up a clod of earth.
This can be thrown.

lines.zh: 闻起来像铁，我舔了一口。
lines.en: Smells like iron; I give it one lick.

lines.zh: 我把它放进嘴里，又吐了。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth and spit it out.
This stick is good.
I swing it once.

lines.zh: 抱起来走两步，胳膊就酸了。
lines.en: Two steps with it and my arms ache.
Is this yours?

lines.zh: 这个给你，我两只爪子捧着。
lines.en: Here, take it; I hold it in both claws.
I keep it. It may be useful.
Something is moving up ahead.
I lower my rear a little.

lines.zh: 再有三步，我牙就够到它。
lines.en: Three more steps and my teeth reach it.
Stand a bit behind me.
My hind legs coil; here I come.
It does not look easy.
Then I go first.
My throat feels warm.
One shout and I go.
One, two, then three.

lines.zh: 脚掌拍着地，我冲出去了。
lines.en: Feet pounding the ground, I'm off.
Do not follow too close.

lines.zh: 它肩一沉，我就知道要动。
lines.en: When its shoulder drops, I know it's about to move.

lines.zh: 它转左，我挪左，别被甩开。
lines.en: It turns left; I shift left and stay with it.

lines.zh: 前爪虚点地，后腿才吃劲。
lines.en: My front claws just touch down; my hind legs take the weight.
When it moves, I move.

lines.zh: 它护着左边，我就看右边。
lines.en: It guards its left, so I keep watching the right.
It has backed toward the stones.
I will not let it behind me.

lines.zh: 追这几步，我鼻子直喷气。
lines.en: After those few steps I'm snorting through my nose.
But I can hold.
It is hesitating.
Now is the chance.
I am charging in at it!
I rake with a claw.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，把它顶偏了。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder in and knock it off balance.

lines.zh: 爪子划过去，只撕开一道。
lines.en: My claws rake across, opening just one line.
My teeth are short, but hard.

lines.zh: 牙咬进它胳膊，我死活不松。
lines.en: My teeth sink into its arm and I won't let go.
It shook me off.
I land and charge again.
I pant, but I am standing.
That should make it retreat.
The blow drove it back.

lines.zh: 它退两步，我就扑第三步。
lines.en: It backs two steps; I pounce on the third.
Stay back. I can do this.

lines.zh: 我站在沙地上，第一次睁眼。
lines.en: I stand on sand, opening my eyes for the first time.
Wind blows sand onto my feet.

lines.zh: 我一开口，声音就出来了。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the sound comes.
Louder than I expected.
I am Agumon.
I remember I must grow stronger.
My claws dig into the soil.
This place is huge.
I look toward the figures.
I can walk, and I can run.
I wait for someone to come.
My belly is empty.
Fire caught me. It burns.
I land on my rear.
Water closes over my snout; my claws scrabble wildly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，尾巴先落地。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, and my tail lands first.

lines.zh: 一支尖东西扎进肩头，我一缩。
lines.en: Something sharp bites my shoulder and I flinch.

lines.zh: 一股怪力缠住腿，我迈不动。
lines.en: Something strange wraps my legs; I can't take a step.
Too hungry; my legs have no strength.
One bolt and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 脚下空空的，我尾巴乱甩。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet; my tail thrashes.
